verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents DIY state backends where users store state themselves in S3/Blob/GCS object stores they control, plus self-hosting options and an open-source core platform, all of which support data portability and avoiding lock-in. However there is no explicit documentation of a stack export/import command in an open data format (e.g. JSON state export) or guidance on fully extracting configuration/secrets to leave the platform. Missing for 10: explicit state/config export format documentation, dedicated 'leave the platform' migration guide, and independent verification that exported state is usable outside Pulumi Cloud.
